title: Flamenco tablao and olé!!!!
text: A spectacle, everyone is very professional, the dancers are the best. The place is very good, the best part is the stage in the center, everyone has a good view and closeness to the artists.
author: Dream08580399669

title: Amazing
text: Wonderful experience, easy to find. Dancers, musicians and singers amazing. A must see and experince.
author: Dalys_C

title: Incredible, thank you!
text: I didn't expect anything coming here, but I left captivated; such energy, such talent, and always with a contagious smile. Best experience by far of my stay in Seville
author: 110thibaultp

title: Passionate
text:
Enjoyable show, great singing, guitar playing and dancing.
Chairs slightly uncomfortable.
author: 710nedzads

title: Essential
text:
The best decision, with very good taste, intimate and small, for locals and foreigners but not touristy at all. The dancers were excellent, pure art, lots of technique and strength, the singer was wonderful and the guitarist was a 10.
We went as a family with two teenagers and they loved it, it went by super fast for us, we would have stayed another hour. Totally recommended.
author: U9316NSelenam

title: Amazing experience...
text: Wow! ... What an amazing performance. So immersive. The intimate space made a perfect setting and the whole experience was simply wonderful. You should do this.
author: PaulR7587

title: Excellent place
text: Quality tablao, you see the show very close to the stage, staff more than welcoming.  A place to recommend in Seville to enjoy an excellent show while sipping a glass of quality wine and taking in a great view of the Guadalquivir.
author: S9893KAelenac

title: Incredible but true
text:
Incredible shows.
The artists live and feel the music and convey all the emotions to us. 
Thanks for everything 
We were so close to the artists... wow!!!
Wonderful memories of Seville. 
The little French sisters from 07/17
author: sejeverome

title: Jaw-dropping intensity.
text: Are you ready to have your mind blown? In this dy and age, it seems a cliche, but this stunning performance will leave you shaken and stirred at the very least. We begin with a solo guitarist and the atmosphere is immediately fixed: personal, emotional, authentic. Not to mention his virtuosity (you can buy the CD after). Then the singer enters. His vocal virtuosity matches the guitarist's, but the clear rapport between them ensures this is not empty technique. This is soul music, Seville style. title: Energy
text: I went to see a flamenco show with a singer, a female dancer, a male dancer, and a guitarist, and I left totally thrilled by the level and energy that these artists gave off.... Totally recommended!!!
